## Verticals
- [Professional Services](https://aivoiceagency.ai/professional-services): Law firms, accounting, agencies, consulting. New client intake, conflict screening, existing client routing, scheduling.
- [Home Services](https://aivoiceagency.ai/home-services): HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest control. Emergency dispatch, estimates, schedule changes, repeat customer routing. Works with ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro, FieldEdge.
- [Medical Practices](https://aivoiceagency.ai/medical-practices): Dental, primary care, specialty, vet, chiropractic. Appointment scheduling, prescription routing, new patient intake, after-hours triage.
- [Transportation](https://aivoiceagency.ai/transportation): Limo, chauffeur, black car, sprinter. Airport runs, corporate accounts, TMC overflow, after-hours bookings. Works with Limo Anywhere, FastTrack, Livery Coach. Includes auto-attendant section and 7 limo-specific FAQs.
- [Hospitality & Events](https://aivoiceagency.ai/hospitality): Hotels, restaurants, event venues, wedding planners. Reservations, event inquiries, vendor routing, front desk overflow.

## Capabilities
- Auto-attendant: AVA also runs as IVR — Press 1 for new requests, Press 2 for existing customers, Press 3 for billing, or stay on the line for direct AVA handling
- Sub-second answer time, 24/7
- Two hundred plus simultaneous calls at peak
- Pushes captured details into CRM, scheduling software, dispatch software, or shared inbox
- Wisconsin pronunciation library (Waukesha, Kewaskum, Oconomowoc, Wauwatosa, Ashwaubenon, etc.)
